Subject: internal: recommended response + order-form redline suggestions

Team —

Quick read: I reviewed VendorCorp's DMCA_notice and the redacted complaint. Below are recommended positions and a proposed set of redlines to the Order Form's indemnity clause if VendorCorp pushes for a broader defense obligation. I attached a tracked-changes doc (proposed_orderform_redline.docx).

Summary recommendations:
1) Narrow scope: push to limit Redwood's obligation to claims arising from Redwood's deliverables and code we authored (preserve carveouts for customer-provided code and data).
2) Defense counsel: insist on Redwood's right to select counsel subject to VendorCorp's reasonable consent (and cost caps).
3) Notice & cure: require VendorCorp to provide prompt written notice and give Redwood a 30-day period to investigate and attempt cure/replacement where technically feasible.
4) Monetary cap: where possible, limit indemnity to direct damages up to the Order Form fee for the prior 12 months, except for IP-specific carveouts where we can negotiate a separate cap.
5) Cooperation: require VendorCorp to provide unredacted evidence under an NDA and to avoid public statements without Redwood's prior consent.

Suggested customer-facing text for acknowledgement/next steps: (short)
"Thanks for the materials. Redwood is reviewing and requests VendorCorp provide full exhibits under the attached limited disclosure agreement so we can complete our technical review. We expect to provide a substantive position within 7 business days of receiving the full exhibits."

Risks / escalation triggers: if VendorCorp demands immediate admission of liability, or if they request Redwood to assume defense counsel selection without limits, escalate to execs for approval (Markus / Legal head).

Next steps: Rafael to send acknowledgement and request NDA link (we've got the DocuSign form in related_links). If VendorCorp shares full exhibits, Legal will triage and we may request a quick technical deep dive from Engineering (estimate 2-3 business days).

Laura Bennett
Director, Contracts & Procurement, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Helen — following up with a coordinated response from Redwood. Thank you for sending the DMCA notice and redacted complaint. Actionable items and next steps below.

1) Acknowledgement (formal):
Redwood Inference acknowledges receipt of VendorCorp's notification dated Aug 27, 2026. We are investigating the matter and have opened an internal case. To proceed with a full technical and legal review we will need access to the unredacted exhibits and any referenced code samples.

2) Evidence sharing:
We can accept materials via one of the following (please confirm):
- HubSpot secure case (preferred) — we will provide a ticket link and S3 intake if needed
- DocuSign limited disclosure (link below) — executes a short confidentiality agreement for exhibits

3) Timeline:
- Please share full exhibits within 48 hours where possible; upon receipt Legal + Engineering will triage within 2-3 business days and provide an initial position within 7 business days. If additional time is required we will notify you immediately.

4) Contract/indemnity posture:
Per our standard Order Form/MSA approach (and subject to review of the exhibits), Redwood typically:
- Reviews to determine whether the alleged infringement arises from Redwood-authored deliverables;
- Seeks to limit indemnity where third-party code, customer modifications, or data are implicated;
- Asserts the right to select defense counsel with reasonable customer input and to manage the defense consistent with cost controls.

If VendorCorp requires different terms (e.g., immediate assumption of defense, broader caps), please flag that requirement now so we can escalate internally.

5) Next steps / asks for VendorCorp:
- Confirm preferred evidence sharing route (HubSpot or DocuSign)
- If HubSpot, please use this link to attach exhibits: https://app.hubspot.com/secure/VC-2026-0953/case/attach (or reply with S3 presigned URLs)
- If you prefer DocuSign NDA, sign here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?acct=XYZ&form=limited-nondisclosure

We appreciate the quick notice. Rafael will coordinate updates; Laura and Marissa will handle contract/legal posture. Markus, copying for awareness in case this escalates to exec review.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
